o.text: Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish انكشاف (inkişaf), from Arabic اِنْكِشَاف (inkišāf).
Inherited from Proto-Turkic *sekiŕ ōn (“eighty”, literally “eight tens”). Equivalent to səkkiz (“eight”) + on (“ten”).
